Joydex runtime IPC third-party licenses and notices

This file covers the NuGet runtime assets selected for Joydex.Ipc on
net8.0-windows7.0 by the restored package graph for StreamJsonRpc 2.25.29 and
System.IO.Pipelines 9.0.1.

Redistributed runtime libraries

- MessagePack.Annotations 2.5.302: MessagePack.Annotations.dll
- MessagePack 2.5.302: MessagePack.dll
- Microsoft.NET.StringTools 18.4.0: Microsoft.NET.StringTools.dll
- Microsoft.VisualStudio.Threading.Only 17.14.15: Microsoft.VisualStudio.Threading.dll
- Microsoft.VisualStudio.Validation 17.13.22: Microsoft.VisualStudio.Validation.dll
- Nerdbank.MessagePack 1.2.4: Nerdbank.MessagePack.dll
- Nerdbank.Streams 2.13.16: Nerdbank.Streams.dll
- Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3: Newtonsoft.Json.dll
- PolyType 1.3.1: PolyType.dll
- StreamJsonRpc 2.25.29: StreamJsonRpc.dll
- System.IO.Pipelines 9.0.1: System.IO.Pipelines.dll

System.Memory 4.6.3 and System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe 6.1.2 also appear
in the resolved package graph. For this target, both select the NuGet `_._`
placeholder for compile and runtime assets, so they contribute no separate DLL
to the redistributed runtime closure.

packages or from files inside the packages. Package-provided third-party notice
files are reproduced verbatim.
